items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 6 at 2:57PM EDT until September 8 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...From 5 AM Monday to 2 PM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
